description:
This file contains the definition of the Response class within the Opencart or
amespace System or
amespace Library. The class manages HTTP response headers, output, and compression for the OpenCart system, including methods for adding headers, redirecting, setting compression levels, and outputting the response content.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents an HTTP response with methods to manage headers, output, compression, and redirection functionalities.

methods.name: addHeader
methods.description: Adds a header string to the response headers array.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Returns the array of response headers.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Performs an HTTP redirect to a specified URL with a given status code.

methods.name: setCompression
methods.description: Sets the compression level for response data.

methods.name: setOutput
methods.description: Sets the output content that will be sent in the response.

methods.name: compress
methods.description: Compresses data using gzip if supported by the client and environment.

methods.name: output
methods.description: Outputs the response content, applying compression if configured, and sends headers.
